title: Yeasty Tender Irish Vermicelli Rice Noodles Bowl
description: A comforting and nostalgic Irish dish featuring vermicelli rice noodles, served with a yeast-based broth and topped with savory ingredients for a keto-friendly meal.
instructions: Bring 4 cups of chicken broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the vermicelli rice noodles and cook for 3-5 minutes, or until slightly tender.
In a small saucepan, melt 1 tbsp of butter and whisk in the active dry yeast. Let it sit for 5 minutes, or until frothy.
Add the garlic, soy sauce, and cooked noodles to the saucepan with the yeast mixture. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the noodles are well coated.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a serving bowl and top with shredded cheddar cheese, chopped parsley, and sliced scallions.
Drizzle the remaining 1 tbsp of butter over the top of the dish and serve hot.
